description:
Stryde: Premium Electrolytes for Better Health and Performance

At Stryde, we’re on a mission to revolutionize hydration and empower people to perform at their best. Designed by athletes for athletes—and anyone seeking to live healthier—we offer premium electrolyte blends that deliver effective hydration without compromise. Every detail of our product, from its science-backed formula to its delicious Strawberry Lemon flavor, has been carefully crafted to meet the needs of a modern, health-conscious lifestyle.

We’re more than just a hydration brand; we’re a community-driven movement localized to Belgium and the Netherlands. From early morning runners to busy professionals and fitness enthusiasts, Stryde is here to fuel their journey with the best hydration solution possible.

And because we focus on serving our local market, all our customer-facing communication, packaging, and support are in Dutch, ensuring that your audience will always feel at home with us.

What Makes Stryde Stand Out?

  1. Expert-Approved Formula: Our product contains the 5 essential electrolytes your body needs to hydrate faster, reduce cramps, and combat dehydration symptoms like headaches and fatigue.
  2. Low Sugar, Maximum Effect: Unlike sugary sports drinks, Stryde delivers hydration without unnecessary additives—perfect for athletes, keto dieters, and anyone who values clean nutrition.
  3. Delicious Taste, No Compromise: Customers rave about our Strawberry Lemon flavor. Hydration should never feel like a chore!
  4. Localized for Belgium and the Netherlands: With Dutch-language communications, fast shipping, and a focus on local customer care, we’re built for these markets.
  5. 100% Conviction: Our team lives and breathes what we sell. As athletes ourselves, we believe in Stryde because it works—and we stand by it wholeheartedly.

Why Partner with Stryde?

  1. Attractive Commission Rates: Earn 15% on every sale, plus performance bonuses as you grow with us.
  2. Custom Discount Codes for Your Audience: Engage your followers with unique, trackable codes.
  3. Premium Product with a Proven Market: Electrolytes are trending, and our science-backed product is positioned perfectly for health and fitness enthusiasts in Belgium and the Netherlands.
  4. Localized Brand: Your audience will appreciate that everything is in Dutch, from our website to our customer service. No language barriers or confusion—just seamless experiences.
  5. Easy-to-Use Affiliate Platform: With seamless tracking, transparent analytics, and on-time payouts, you’ll always know how your efforts are paying off.
  6. Access to High-Quality Resources: From professional visuals to tested ad copy, we give you the tools to succeed.
  7. Collaborative Support: Our team is here to help you grow, whether it’s crafting campaigns or answering questions.

Who Are We Looking For?

We’re seeking passionate micro-influencers, bloggers, and content creators in the health, fitness, and lifestyle space who:

  • Share our vision for healthy living and optimal performance.
  • Have a highly engaged audience interested in wellness, fitness, or hydration solutions.
  • Are based in Belgium or the Netherlands, with followers who value localized brands and communication.

How Does the Affiliate Program Work?

  1. Sign Up: Join through our easy-to-use affiliate portal.
  2. Promote: Share your unique affiliate link or discount code with your audience.
  3. Earn: Receive a commission on every sale made through your efforts, with no cap on your earnings.

Together, We Thrive

When you join the Stryde affiliate program, you’re not just promoting a product—you’re partnering with a local, Dutch-speaking brand that’s redefining hydration and empowering people to reach their potential.

Let’s stride forward together and make waves in the health and wellness space in Belgium and the Netherlands.

Ready to Join Us?
Let’s turn your passion into profit. Apply now and start earning while promoting a product you’ll love sharing with your audience!
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Stryde! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: nathan@stryde.shop.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to nathan@stryde.shop for support.
